== Notes ==
* Damage will not occur if this enchantment is removed with a [[teardown]] attack (or by any means other than hitting an enemy). This is the case even if the teardown hits multiple enemies (using a scythe).
* Attacks with ranged weapons cause damage to be dealt to other foes near the target rather than yourself.
